recipes.name: Apple Potato Mash (Hete bliksem)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53389. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Clean and peel the potatoes and cut them into even size chunks. Boil them in salted water for about 10 min and then add the cleaned and chopped apples into the boiling water. Add the cinnamon stick as well. Leave to boil for another 10 minutes or until both apples and potatoes are to your liking. I like mine to be fairly chunky but that is a personal preference

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In the mean time bake the streaky bacon in a dry frying pan until crispy and set aside to drain on paper towels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Slice a few apple pieces and melt a little butter in a fryin pan. Add the apple slices to it and add a bit of maple syrup into the pan as well as some cinnamon. Let it simmer until the apple is soft.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Prepare a plate with one whisked egg and one plate with sesame seeds. Cut your cheese into the required size. The smaller it is, the easier it is too handle.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Dip the cheese into the egg and make sure it coats all sides. Then dip the cheese into the sesame seeds and make sure it is covered everywhere.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Heat a non stick frying pan on high until nice and hot. Put the cheese slice in and bake until the sesame seeds are brown. You have to do this rather quickly or the cheese will melt completely. Turn and bake the other side.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Drain the apples and potatoes and mash them together. Taste and add cinnamon and salt where needed. Remove the cinnamon stick before mashing

recipes.name: Runner Bean Mash (Snijbonen Stamppot)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53388. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Wash and chop the runner beans. Place in a saucepan with salted water and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook the beans for about 10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, add the potatoes and cook until tender.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat a small skillet with a little butter and sauté the onion until translucent. Add the garlic and cook briefly. Add the runner beans to the pan and stir-fry for a few minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, mash the potatoes with a masher. Add a knob of butter and a splash of milk. Add the bean mixture and grated cheese. Season with salt, pepper and mustard.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Fry the bacon and serve with the bean mash.

recipes.name: Snert (Dutch Split Pea Soup)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52981. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Gather the ingredients.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In a large soup pot, bring water, split peas, pork belly or bacon, pork chop, and bouillon cube to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer, cover and let cook for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally and skimming off any foam that rises to the top.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Remove the pork chop, debone, and thinly slice the meat. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the celery, carrots, potato, onion, leek, and celeriac to the soup. Return to the boil, reduce the heat to a simmer and let cook, uncovered, for another 30 minutes, adding a little extra water if the ingredients start to stick to the bottom of the pot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add the smoked sausage for the last 15 minutes of cooking time. When the vegetables are tender, remove the bacon and smoked sausage, slice thinly and set aside.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: If you prefer a smooth consistency, purée the soup with a stick blender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Add the meat back to the soup, setting some slices of rookworst aside.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Serve in heated bowls or soup plates, garnished with slices of rookworst and chopped celery leaf.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Enjoy!
